snippet.title: VANRAN – Brutal Soulslike Action RPG | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3449370/VANRAN/?l=koreana

A rebellion born in hell.

VANRAN is a story-driven Soulslike action RPG.
You play as Caleb, Grand Marshal of the North, cast into the Demon Realm after a failed uprising.

Fast-paced and brutal combat.
Relentless aggression and precise timing decide survival.
Hesitation means death.

This trailer features actual gameplay footage from VANRAN,
showcasing its combat, world, and dark fantasy atmosphere.

🎮 Steam Demo Available
January 23 – January 30, 2026

🕯️ Platforms: Steam / PlayStation 5 / Xbox

Walk the path through hell.
